verdict.rationale: Vercel's own CLI deploys a project with the bare `vercel` command after install and login, and the docs describe a short install-then-deploy flow. However, nothing in the pack documents the CLI scaffolding a new project. Templates are mentioned only as a separate path from the CLI, so the scaffold-plus-deploy-in-one-command part of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: a documented CLI scaffold/init command, evidence that scaffold and deploy happen in a single command, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can scaffold and deploy a new project with a single CLI command

citations.quote: Deploy your app on Vercel in three steps: install the CLI, add agent support if you use an AI coding agent, and deploy.
Get started by importing a project, choosing a template, or using the Vercel CLI.
